# genesyscloud_agentic_virtual_agent (Resource)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/resources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Genesys Cloud Agentic Virtual Agent

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this resource. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/agentic/virtualagents](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-agentic-virtualagents)
* [POST /api/v2/agentic/virtualagents](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#post-api-v2-agentic-virtualagents)
* [GET /api/v2/agentic/virtualagents/{virtualAgentId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-agentic-virtualagents--virtualAgentId-)
* [PATCH /api/v2/agentic/virtualagents/{virtualAgentId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#patch-api-v2-agentic-virtualagents--virtualAgentId-)
* [DELETE /api/v2/agentic/virtualagents/{virtualAgentId}/jobs](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#delete-api-v2-agentic-virtualagents--virtualAgentId--jobs)
* [GET /api/v2/agentic/virtualagents/{virtualAgentId}/jobs/{jobId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-agentic-virtualagents--virtualAgentId--jobs--jobId-)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `agentic:virtualAgent:add`
* `agentic:virtualAgent:edit`
* `agentic:virtualAgent:view`
* `agentic:virtualAgentJob:add`
* `agentic:virtualAgentJob:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `agentic-virtualagents`
* `agentic-virtualagents:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "genesyscloud_agentic_virtual_agent" "example_agent" {
  name      = "Customer Support Agent"
  image_uri = "https://example.com/images/agent-avatar.png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the agentic virtual agent. Must be unique per organization (case-insensitive).

### Optional

- `image_uri` (String) URI for the agent's avatar image. Must be a valid HTTPS URL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `latest_production_ready_version` (String) Version number of the latest production-published version.
- `latest_saved_version` (String) Version number of the latest created/updated version.
- `status` (String) Current status of the agent. 'Draft' when no version is published for production, 'Published' when one is.
